name: UAC

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive
rows.derivedFormula: Cost of Sales = Revenue - Gross Profit

source_note: Profit before tax is the audited statement line "Profit/(loss) before minimum tax": NGN 16,425,008 thousand for FY2025 and NGN 25,547,275 thousand for FY2024 (NGX filing 46413). The terminal has no row for the separate minimum tax line, so profit before tax less the stored income tax row exceeds profit for the year by the minimum tax (810,641 in FY2025, 400,427 in FY2024). Figures NGN thousands. | H1 2026 column from the company filing (https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/47625_UAC__OF_NIGERIA_PLC.-_QUARTER_2_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_JULY_2026.pdf): revenue, profit after tax and EPS only; other lines blank because the release did not state them. UNIT CHECK: values whose magnitude did not reconcile with the annual column were withheld (filing unit differed from the statement unit); they were not rescaled. UNIT APPLIED: figures converted x1000 from the unit stated in the filing (e.g. Kshs '000). Conversion only where the result reconciles with the annual column.
derivedCellsNote: Individual blank cells derived from the same file own printed inputs, each tagged derived true with its formula and identity agreement rate.
